_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We serve three primary target markets: wireless communications, wired infrastructure and industrial & other', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2013 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of analog semiconductor devices with a focus on III-V based products', 'We serve three primary target markets: wireless communications, wired infrastructure and industrial & other', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2013 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.55x; +169% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.21; conservative 2yr +98%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY08-FY13 ex-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +106.9%/yr (Q3 FY14 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 4.6-yr ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +106.9%/yr (FY08-FY13 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY13 ex-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2014-05-30) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.55x (66.0% downside to Bear $24.01 / +120.1% upside to Bull $155.54) | Adj composite 2.80 vs market 1.59: gap +1.21 [UNDERVALUED] | +169% above the EPP floor $26.28 (12x FY14E $2.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: +98.3% total (+49.1%/yr) | At 32.3x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $93.46 sits at or below the BASE case; net revenue +24.7% YoY in Q2 FY14, forward revenues +101.9-117.4% (Q3 FY14 revenue guide (Q2 FY14 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
